notes.title: The development of the gameplay part is officially complete!
notes.content:
[p]We are happy to share that after 6 months of painstaking and diligent work, we have finished developing the gameplay part and moved on to the polishing stage. Here are the few items we have left to implement:[/p][p]1. Draw the main menu;[/p][p]2. Polish the smoothness of transitions between animations;[/p][p]3. Implement character selection;[/p][p]4. Implement achievements;[/p][p]and MOST IMPORTANTLY — successfully pass alpha testing.[/p][p]If you want to become one of our testers, join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/vuDCNFmH4s" style="button" buttoncolor="#5662f6"]Discord[/url] channel.
[/p][previewyoutube="3dZ6mWshR8Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3589530/REGRET/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.content:
